title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
description: A classic Continental dish featuring tender chicken breast stuffed with ham and Swiss cheese, coated in crisp breadcrumbs, and served with a rich Mornay or Dijon cream sauce.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken
items: Boneless chicken breasts – 4 pieces (about 180–200 g each)
Sliced cooked ham – 4 slices (thin, good quality)
Swiss cheese (Emmental or Gruyère preferred) – 4 slices
Breadcrumbs (fine, preferably panko or fresh white) – 1 cup
Oil for shallow frying – as required

ingredients.title: For the Sauce (Classic Mornay or Dijon Cream Sauce)
items: Grated Gruyère or Parmesan cheese – 2 tbsp
Lemon juice – a few drops (optional, to brighten the flavor)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Chicken
steps: Place each chicken breast between two sheets of plastic wrap or parchment paper.
Gently pound to an even thickness of about 1 cm (½ inch).
Season both sides with salt and white pepper.
Lightly brush one side with Dijon mustard.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Assemble
steps: Lay a slice of ham and a slice of cheese over each flattened chicken breast.
Roll tightly like a roulade, tucking the ends to seal the filling.
Secure with toothpicks or wrap tightly in cling film and chill for 20–30 minutes to firm up.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Breading
steps: Dredge each roll lightly in flour, shaking off excess.
Dip in beaten egg, then coat evenly with breadcrumbs.
Chill again for 10–15 minutes to set the coating (ensures crispness).

instruction.title: Step 4 – Frying & Finishing
steps: Heat oil and butter in a pan over medium heat.
Shallow-fry each roll until golden brown on all sides.
Transfer to a baking tray and finish in a preheated oven at 180°C (350°F) for 10–12 minutes, ensuring the internal cheese melts and the chicken is cooked through (core temp: 74°C / 165°F).
Rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Sauce Preparation
steps: Melt butter in a small saucepan, add flour, and cook for 1 minute without browning.
Gradually whisk in warm milk until smooth and thickened.
Add cheese, mustard, salt, and pepper.
Finish with a few drops of lemon juice for brightness.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Plating & Presentation
steps: Slice the Chicken Cordon Bleu diagonally to reveal the cheese and ham layers.
Nap (not drown) with Mornay or Dijon cream sauce.
Garnish with microgreens or finely chopped parsley.
Serve with buttered vegetables, mashed potatoes, or a light garden salad.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve with buttered vegetables, mashed potatoes, or a light garden salad.
Serve immediately while the cheese is hot and melted.
Pair with a crisp green salad for a balanced meal.

chefTips: Use Gruyère or Emmental for an authentic nutty melt; mozzarella can be used for a milder flavor.
Chilling before frying helps retain shape and prevent cheese leakage.
For a lighter version, bake entirely in the oven after brushing with melted butter.
